purpose: Expected claim-to-source links the Phase 2 evidence linker should produce. Statuses follow the EvidenceLink vocabulary plus explicit 'manual_review_required' for non-deterministic cases.

expected_evidence_links.rationale: Pivotal endpoint claim ('87.4% response rate at 12 months') in CER.docx span_b0fecd4907e13acc has an explicit (Smith et al., 2023) citation that resolves to bibliography/source-study.pdf, which contains the same value on page 1. Direct evidence chain.
expected_evidence_links.notes: This is the canonical 'green' evidence link for the demo. If extraction succeeds end-to-end, this link should be the most visually compelling proof in the buyer demo.

expected_evidence_links.rationale: Safety claim ('Adverse event rate was 3.2%') in CER.docx span_8c8ef5d659e6ba6d has no in-line author-year citation, but the same n=412 cohort wording appears in source-study.pdf page 2. Resolution relies on cohort-size co-occurrence rather than a citation marker.
expected_evidence_links.notes: Lower-confidence than GOLD-EVIDENCE-001 because the link is inferred from population alignment, not from an explicit marker. Phase 2 may legitimately downgrade this to manual_review_required if the linker only trusts explicit citations.

expected_evidence_links.rationale: GSPR-05 'Software lifecycle per IEC 62304' has no Evidence_Document cell at all (blank in the seed fixture, absent from spans). No file path to attempt to resolve against. This is the planted completeness gap.

Benefit-risk conclusion ('benefit-risk profile is acceptable') in CER.docx span_05f0a0e4c6224e9f cites '[1]' but the marker does not resolve to any local source. The claim is therefore unsupported by any deterministic chain.
expected_evidence_links.notes: Conservative language: 'potentially unsupported, requires manual review'. Drives GOLD-FINDING-003.

expected_evidence_links.rationale: Device classification ('Class IIa') is a regulatory judgment, not a citation-bearing claim. Even with a perfect linker, this should remain manual_review_required.
expected_evidence_links.notes: Drives GOLD-FINDING-005 (ECO-MANUAL informational). Severity stays Informational; no deterministic verdict possible.

expected_evidence_links.rationale: GSPR-03 references PMS.docx as Evidence_Document, but PMS.docx is not present in fixtures/demo_dossier/. The reference is structurally present but the file is missing.
expected_evidence_links.notes: Different from GOLD-EVIDENCE-003: here a filename IS declared, just unresolvable. Drives a future GSPR-evidence completeness check; severity is currently scoped as Minor in GOLD-FINDING-006 because Status='Met' is asserted despite the missing file.

expected_evidence_links.rationale: GSPR-04 references Labeling.pdf with Status='Not Met'. The file is missing, but the status field already acknowledges non-conformance — so the cross-doc finding is informational only.
expected_evidence_links.notes: See GOLD-FINDING-007. This is a softer case than GSPR-03 because the dossier itself flags the gap.

uncertainty_notes: GOLD-EVIDENCE-002 (safety claim) is the riskiest annotation: the link is inferred, not cited. If Phase 2 cannot reliably distinguish co-occurrence from causation, this should be downgraded to manual_review_required rather than treated as a recall miss.
